statement_en: If $f\in \mathbb{C}[x]$ is a monic polynomial with all roots satisfying $\lvert z\rvert \leq r$ for some $r<2$, then must\[\{ z: \lvert f(z)\rvert <1\}\]have a connected component with diameter $>2-r$?
statement_lean:
open Polynomial Erdos1043

def openLevelSet (f : Polynomial ℂ) : Set ℂ :=
  {z : ℂ | ‖f.eval z‖ < 1}

theorem erdos_96993 :
    ∀ (r : ℝ) (f : ℂ[X]), 0 < r → r < 2 → f.Monic → f.degree ≥ 1 → (∀ z ∈ f.roots, ‖z‖ ≤ r) →
      ∃ z ∈ openLevelSet f, ENNReal.ofReal (2 - r) <
        Metric.ediam (connectedComponentIn (openLevelSet f) z) := by
  sorry
